verdict.rationale: Decagon documents a first-party Voice AI agent product and outbound calling. Its integrations explicitly let the agent retrieve data and take actions across chat, email, and voice, so shared actions across channels are supported. However, inbound phone telephony, the speech-in/speech-out pipeline, and shared knowledge (help center/AOPs) between voice and chat are only implied, and nothing independent corroborates them. missing for 10: explicit documentation of inbound phone-call handling and telephony, explicit evidence that voice uses the same knowledge base/AOPs as chat, speech recognition/synthesis details, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent handles phone calls — speech in, speech out — with the same knowledge and actions as chat

citations.quote: Voice AI agents built for natural, multilingual conversations and customized to your brand.
They ensure your agent can retrieve data, take action, and handle escalations smoothly across chat, email, and voice channels with no custom code required.
Initiate intelligent, on-brand calls that reliably reach customers at the right moments throughout their journey.
Simulations, Decagon's integrated testing suite, help teams validate agent behavior across channels before deploying to production
